adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6` the `save()` action sends `props.category_id = this.get('categoryId')`, which will be `null` when no category is chosen. The server explicitly falls back to `SiteSetting.uncategorized_category_id` when `category_id.blank?` (in `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#save_host`). However, after `host.save(props)` resolves, the client unconditionally runs `host.set('category', Discourse.Category.findById(this.get('categoryId')));`. If `categoryId` is `null`, this sets `category` to `findById(null)` (effectively blank/undefined), overriding the server-side fallback until reload.
